reference_sql:
WITH purchases AS (
  -- one row per purchase from 26 November to 2 December 2025
  SELECT event_date,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value AS v
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251126' AND '20251202'
)
SELECT event_date, COUNT(*) AS purchases,
  SUM(COALESCE(v.int_value, v.float_value, v.double_value)) AS purchase_value
FROM purchases
GROUP BY event_date
alternatives:
SELECT e.event_date, COUNT(*) AS purchases,
  SUM(COALESCE(p.value.int_value, p.value.float_value, p.value.double_value)) AS purchase_value
FROM events AS e, unnest(e.event_params) AS t(p)
WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20251126' AND '20251202'
  AND p.key = 'value'
GROUP BY e.event_date

SELECT event_date, COUNT(*) AS purchases, SUM(ecommerce.purchase_revenue) AS purchase_value
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '20251126' AND '20251202'
GROUP BY event_date
